==Enemies==
'''Normal''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Abnormal]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 1 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]], [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] and [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] modes
**[[Abnormal/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Abnormal Boss]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 10 in some challenges
**[[Abnormal Boss/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Normal]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 1 in [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]] and [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] modes
**[[Normal/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Normal Boss]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 7 in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] and [[Casual Mode|Casual]] modes
**[[Normal Boss/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Elite Abnormal]], a high health enemy that first appears on wave 8 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode
**[[Elite Abnormal/Advanced Stats]]
